text: Resolve an investment by saved ID, full name, market, quote currency and share class, not ticker or alias alone. A definition creates neither a holding nor a trade. Managed product instruments use their product workflow. For directory edits, omission keeps a field, null clears only explicitly clearable fields, and an empty string does not mean clear. Directory mutations are direct operations; they do not produce a ledger plan.

Use date/compareTo for endpoints; from/to for 1–31 closed days in household history timezone. Endpoint movement includes principal, not investment return. Filters select leaves; totals/reconciliation may stay household-wide. Never sum account rollups with components. Single-date pending: get_historical_overview with date, filter={included:true,quality:"pending"}, view="evidence". Pending means carried price/FX, not missing valuation. Do not scan all rows or regex JSON (carriedCount:0 is normal); check pendingContribution > 0 on counted leaves. Follow only relevant filtered cursors.

Completed facts only: exact amounts/currencies and copied IDs. Salary: money_added/income; spending: money_removed/expense (kind/reason). Own-account moves: cash_transfer; balance fixes: reconciliation. Debt: debt_draw/debt_payment; principal is not spending. FX source affects valuation only; fx_conversion needs actual amounts/fees. Valuation is not spendable cash; definitions are not ownership. position_import needs original quantity/cost; trades need executions. Inspect preview, then commit_plan. Local: YYYY-MM-DD/HH:MM. Preserve seconds: RFC3339 effectiveAt, confirmed offset, no local fields. Never truncate or guess.

A managed deposit or locked product is a contract with specialized cash, maturity and reservation rules. Read its contract, operations and actual cash. Maturity, due_unconfirmed and forecast interest are not received money. Do not double-count product value in account cash. Product rollups and their detailed holdings are overlapping evidence. Ordinary trade, quote and reconciliation tools do not replace managed-product operations.

Record one completed managed-product fact using its matching payload. Existing products require evidenced totalCostBasis/currentValue and explicit cashExcludesProduct; never infer original cost from current value. Settlement closes the whole contract, not a partial redemption. Renewal requires actual settlement and successor terms. Reservation creation, edit or release, including renewal/undo that would change reservations, uses the App. A forecast lock does not prove cash receipt. Preview effects before commit_plan; returned provisional IDs are not committed IDs.

Keep instrument identity, currency, unit, price basis and source time together. Unit NAV is not cumulative NAV or annualized yield. A daily date is the source market/NAV/reference date; retrieval time is not a new observation. A carried value is not newly published. Agent observations require actual source evidence; a source URL is provenance and is not fetched by the App. Observation imports and FX source preferences affect valuation, not currency balances. Active-history absence does not establish absence of withdrawn/corrected records; use Agent audit/import comparison for that question.

A successful fact import does not prove complete derived valuation. Distinguish missing inputs, pending coverage and actionable repair. Repair previews estimate work; start replans, and its receipt acknowledges submission rather than completion. Read job status, then scan fresh health after a terminal outcome. Agent-only supply requires real NAV/FX evidence; provider repair cannot invent it.

Reconcile to an evidenced target balance, quantity or cost; do not disguise a correction as income or a trade. Preserve effective and recorded dates and explain replay effects. Session-linked changes require the disclosed session/item revisions; a correction alone does not confirm a completeness check. Read current evidence before preview, inspect normalized effects, commit the returned plan and verify current state.

Daily investment review is a reminder, not a sell recommendation or ledger entry. A closed-day predicate and triggerPolicy are separate: single, consecutive count, or rolling windowDays/minHits. Missing evidence is unknown, not a hit; today is unclosed. Use the complete advertised spec: fixed version/evaluator/dataPolicy, target, predicate, schedule and triggerPolicy. Predicate root is all/any with at most two group levels and 20 leaves. amount/cost compare exact money with currency and fxMode; price_change/annualized use percent and a 7/30/90/180/365-day lookback. Annualized conditions need an eligible type gate in the same all path. Choose an explicit fixed IANA timezone. The synthetic example illustrates format; replace its timezone, scope and threshold with the user's intent.
